'''The Underlurker''' was a massive creature living during the [[Galactic War]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], in the caverns beneath the [[Temple of Sacrifice]]. In [[3637 BBY]] a coalition of Republic and Imperial forces used those caverns to reach the Temple and stop [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] from activating the [[Temple of Sacrifice artifact|artifact]] inside it. On their way, they engaged the Underlurker and [[Death/Legends|killed]] it.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Underlurker appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion as a boss during "The Temple of Sacrifice" operation.
